## listTracked

List Tracked Links. `GET /tracked-links`

List all tracked links for tenant with pagination and filtering.

Query Parameters: - page: Page number (1-indexed, default: 1) - page_size: Items per page (1-100, default: 20) - search: Search term for original_url, label, short_code, or custom_alias - feature_type: Filter by feature type (email_campaign, conversation, etc.) - tags: Filter by tags (returns links matching ANY of the provided tags)

```php
$result = $sendseven->linkTracking()->listTracked();
```

- Scopes: `link_tracking:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page (max 100) |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Search in original_url, label, short_code, or custom_alias |
| `$featureType` | `FeatureType\|string\|null` | no | Filter by feature type |
| `$tags` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Filter by tags (any match) |

Returns `TrackedLinkList`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Link%20Tracking/list_tracked_links_api_v1_tracked_links_get)

## createTracked

Create Tracked Link. `POST /tracked-links`

Create a tracked link with short URL.

Returns a short URL that redirects to the original URL while tracking clicks.

```php
$result = $sendseven->linkTracking()->createTracked(originalUrl: 'original_url');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$originalUrl` | `string` | yes | Full destination URL |
| `$featureType` | `FeatureType\|string\|null` | no | Feature using this tracked link (defaults to OTHER) |
| `$featureId` | `?string` | no | ID of campaign/conversation/etc. |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Intended recipient (optional) |
| `$metadata` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Additional context |
| `$expiresInDays` | `?int` | no | Days until expiration (default: 365) |
| `$label` | `?string` | no | User-friendly label for the link |
| `$trackingMode` | `TrackingMode\|string\|null` | no | Tracking granularity. 'shared' (default) = one link for all recipients. 'per_recipient' = template link cloned per recipient at send time; requires feature_type=REACH or EMAIL_CAMPAIGN and feature_id. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `TrackedLink`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Link%20Tracking/create_tracked_link_api_v1_tracked_links_post)

## bulkCreateTracked

Bulk Create Tracked Links. `POST /tracked-links/bulk`

## createManualTracked

Create Manual Tracked Link. `POST /tracked-links/manual`

Create a manual tracked link for the standalone URL shortener.

Creates a new shortened URL with an auto-generated 8-character code. Uses feature_type=OTHER for manual links. Uses tenant's preferred tracking domain from settings.

```php
$result = $sendseven->linkTracking()->createManualTracked(originalUrl: 'original_url');
```

- Scopes: `link_tracking:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$originalUrl` | `string` | yes | Full destination URL to shorten |
| `$customAlias` | `?string` | no | Custom short code/alias (e.g., 'summer-sale'). Must be unique. Only lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), and hyphens (-) allowed. |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Contact UUID for personalized link tracking (optional) |
| `$label` | `?string` | no | User-friendly label for the link |
| `$tags` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Tags for categorization (e.g., ['marketing', 'social']) |
| `$expiresInDays` | `?int` | no | Days until expiration (default: 365) |
| `$trackingDomain` | `?string` | no | Tracking domain to use for this link. If not provided, uses the tenant's default from settings. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `TrackedLinkDetail`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Link%20Tracking/create_manual_tracked_link_api_v1_tracked_links_manual_post)

## deleteTracked

Delete Tracked Link. `DELETE /tracked-links/{link_id}`

Delete a tracked link.

By default, performs a soft delete (sets is_active=False). Use hard_delete=true to permanently remove the link and all click data.

```php
$result = $sendseven->linkTracking()->deleteTracked(linkId: 'link_id');
```

- Scopes: `link_tracking:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$linkId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$hardDelete` | `?bool` | no | If true, permanently delete. If false, soft delete (deactivate). |

Returns `DeleteTrackedLink`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Link%20Tracking/delete_tracked_link_api_v1_tracked_links__link_id__delete)
